financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Shares issued to Lincoln Park Capital under equity purchase agreement (exact date not given; filing date used as latest possible date)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: Subsequent to June 30, 2023, in connection with its equity purchase agreement with LPC, the Company received proceeds of approximately $0.8 million from the issuance of 1.0 million shares of the Company’s common stock

warrants.quote: In connection with its public offering the Company issued warrants to purchase 108,181 shares of the Company’s common stock with an exercise price of $6.5625 per share.

On January 19, 2023, the Company issued warrants to purchase 30,000 shares of the Company’s common stock with an exercise price of $3.00 per share as consideration to waive the lock-up restriction related to its August IPO.

On February 6, 2023, the Company issued warrants to purchase 800,000 shares of the Company’s common stock with an exercise price of $3.25 per share in connection with the issuance of its 2023 Note (See Note 6).

On March 7, 2023, the Company issued warrants to purchase 112,000 shares of the Company’s common stock with an exercise price of $3.50 per share as consideration to waive the lock-up restriction related to its August IPO.
